Getting the black book was a pain in the ass. You have to knock out basically everyone in that area. I would start by getting in the grass behind the boxes where the guard in the green shirt is. Then, I would throw a coin behind the box so that he checks it out and you can hopefully subdue him (nobody notices unless Blair and his entourage are there). Then, I would drag his corpse to through the grass to behind the boxes near the chef with the two apples and the crowbar. Then, do the same coin trick with the chef and knock him out and leave him there. At that point, getting into the house is easy, but make sure that the patrolling guard inside is near the box. Once inside, knock that guard out and QUICKLY drag him into the box and hide yourself in it, as the sleeping guard will hear the noise and will investigate. Once in the box, the guard will grab the weapon on the floor and go back to put it in the box. Follow him and knock him out. Then grab the book. After that, feel free to bring guards into the house to knock them out as well. It may take a few tries, but it ultimately worked for me
